non_interactive.description: If true, run in non-interactive mode (equivalent to --non-interactive)

apt_opts.description: List of APT configuration options (e.g., ['APT::Get::Fix-Broken="true"']) matching --option=APT_OPTS format

root_dir.description: Alternative root directory for chroot installs (equivalent to --root=ROOTDIR)

quiet.description: If true, suppress progress information (equivalent to --quiet)

apt_line.description: If true, simulate only and print apt-get install line (equivalent to --apt-line)
